conclusion.interpretation: One complete paired trajectory: Loom used fewer generations (94 vs100) and total tool calls (84 vs89), but more input and output overall. Loom includes one protocol-environment shell probe and83 business tools; no actual Worker API call. Larger history/context per generation accompanies the overhead. Exact causal protocol versus stochastic business share is not identifiable; no cost is subtracted.
conclusion.firstRequest: Actual first generation: native7565 vs Loom9379, delta1814 tokens before generated history diverges. Later first-generation sums include differing histories, so do not label those fixed overhead.
conclusion.publication: All24 captured per-turn request sequences end at their final native stop, with no subsequent provider generation in that turn; product has12 final-output markers. Recorder lacks exact publication timestamps, so avoid stronger wall-clock causality claims.
